messages:

Cc: finance@brightlane.com
Date: 2028-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Annual prepay cadence and escrow release thresholds

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Finance asked me to lock down the exact invoicing cadence for our annual prepay and the mechanics for scheduled drawdowns from escrow. Two quick asks so we can finish procurement: 

1) Can you confirm the monthly vs. milestone invoicing options you support for a $1.2M annual commitment? We need an example ledger CSV we can test with our AP system.
2) We operate in US and Ireland — I need the VAT/tax id you expect on the invoice and any supporting VAT certificate we should attach to PO packages.

If you can send a sample CSV and a checklist for the escrow threshold releases (e.g., what triggers a monthly sweep vs. a milestone withdrawal), that would be hugely helpful.

Appreciate it — aiming to submit the PO by next Friday.

Best,
Alys Chen
Finance Programs Manager
BrightLane

Attachment: none
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Alys Chen <alys.chen@brightlane.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence and escrow release thresholds

Hi Alys — thanks for the clear asks. Summary and next steps below; attaching a sample CSV and the draft amendment for escrow routing.

Summary (options):
- Monthly sweep (recommended for predictable cashflow): Invoice issued on the 1st of month, funds released from escrow within 3 business days of confirmed invoice posting.
- Milestone-triggered drawdown: Larger releases tied to usage or feature gates (we can map to BrightLane milestones).

Practical tradeoffs:
- Monthly sweep: simpler ledger rows (one line per month), lower operational cadence for both teams, small-unit accounting on our side.
- Milestone: fewer withdrawals (reduces wire fees) but requires milestone acceptance sign-off (DocuSign) which can add 2–5 business days.

What I attached:
- drawdown_schedule_sample.csv — example ledger columns: invoice_date, invoice_number, gross_amount_usd, vat_amount_usd, net_amount_usd, escrow_release_date, release_reason, settlement_account
- redwood-escrow-amendment-unsigned.docx — language our legal team prefers for escrow authorization (we can circle back on custom clauses).

VAT and invoices:
- For US (no VAT): we’ll issue standard commercial invoice with Redwood vendor details and US tax notes.
- For Ireland/EU: please confirm the VAT number BrightLane wants on invoice (we accept either BrightLane’s VAT or your Irish branch VAT). I attached a blank VAT evidence checklist — if you can return the VAT number and a scanned VAT registration certificate we’ll include it on the invoice and on the PDF package.

Next steps:
1) Marissa will confirm the exact settlement account string and wire cutoffs for escrow releases.
2) I will send the DocuSign amendment prefilled for the milestone path if you prefer that route.
3) Alys: if you prefer monthly sweeps, sign the attached CSV template and return the VAT certificate for Ireland.

DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/XXY-escrow-amendment-5042
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5042/HB-4729

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: drawdown_schedule_sample.csv, redwood-escrow-amendment-unsigned.docx
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence and escrow release thresholds

Vivek — quick ops notes to include in the external reply:

1) Settlement account string: Redwood Ops / Escrow Account — Bank of West, ABA 122000496, Account 987654321. All releases processed by 10:30am PT cut on release day; wire shows same day for domestic, next business day for EUR routing.
2) VAT evidence: for EU invoices we require either the customer VAT number or a VAT certificate (pdf). Our billing system will apply reverse charge if we have the EU VAT on file and the customer qualifies.
3) CSV sample: ensure the sample has separate rows for VAT reconciliation — column vat_status with values: "reverse_charge", "vat_applied", "vat_exempt". That helps AP teams map to their tax engine.

Also suggest we offer BrightLane the option to do monthly sweeps but auto-fallback to milestone for months where usage spikes exceed 150% of monthly average; that reduces over-withdrawal risk.

I updated the CSV (minor tweaks) and uploaded a redwood-vat-certificate-eu.pdf stub (for their records) — attaching.

Marissa Cole
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vat_certificate_eu.pdf
From: Alys Chen <alys.chen@brightlane.com>

Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence and escrow release thresholds

Thanks Vivek and Marissa — this is very helpful. A few clarifications before we finalize PO: 

- We prefer the monthly sweep model but with the auto-fallback to milestone when usage >150% as Marissa suggested. Please call this the "monthly+cap" option on the amendment.
- VAT: BrightLane Ireland VAT ID is IE3421589F — attached is our VAT registration (sending to you off-thread). Can you confirm the invoice will display that VAT and that Redwood will not apply VAT if reverse charge criteria met?
- CSV: we'll ingest your sample. Can you confirm the invoice_number pattern (we need it to include the HubSpot deal id for reconciliation)?

If everything checks out, I can route PO this afternoon and return the signed DocuSign amendment for the monthly+cap flow.

Best,
Alys

Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence and escrow release thresholds (final confirmations)

Alys — quick operational confirmations so your AP team has exact values to map in the PO and AP system: 

1) Invoice_number pattern: RDW-{deal_id}-{YYYYMM}-{seq} — for your deal that will be RDW-HB-4729-202805-001 (we will increment seq per invoice). Please confirm this works for your ERP.
2) VAT handling: with your IE3421589F on file we will mark EU invoices as reverse_charge and set vat_status=reverse_charge in the CSV row; vat_amount_usd will be 0 and we will include a vat_note on the PDF invoice confirming reverse charge treatment.
3) Escrow release timing: for monthly+cap, standard release window is 3 business days after invoice_post_date; if usage spikes above cap we trigger a milestone release which requires DocuSign sign-off (we will send a one-click acceptance link for speed).

Action items: 
- Vivek: send prefilled DocuSign amendment with monthly+cap language (today).
- Marissa: send final CSV sample (we'll attach to the first invoice) and confirm bank wire notes in the invoice footer.
- Alys: return signed DocuSign and uploaded VAT cert to the HubSpot deal.

I'll update the HubSpot deal and tag finance ops so we have a 1:1 handoff at PO submission.

Thanks — looking forward to the PO.

Karthik Iyer
Finance Partnerships Lead
Redwood Inference
